description: A state-issued certificate of good standing (certificate of fact of good standing, certificate of existence) for a business entity.

issuing_state.description: The state whose Secretary of State (or equivalent office) issued the certificate, e.g. 'Colorado'.

issuing_office.description: The issuing office as named in the certificate heading, e.g. 'Office of the Secretary of State of the State of Colorado'.

certificate_title.description: The title of the certificate exactly as printed, e.g. 'Certificate of Fact of Good Standing'.

entity.description: The business entity the certificate is about.

name.description: The entity's legal name exactly as printed on the certificate.

entity_type.description: The entity's legal form as printed, e.g. 'Nonprofit Corporation', 'Limited Liability Company'.

jurisdiction.description: The state or country under whose law the entity was formed or registered.

formation_date.description: The date the entity was formed or registered, exactly as printed on the certificate (e.g. MM/DD/YYYY). Do not reformat.

entity_id_number.description: The entity identification (ID) number the state assigned to the entity, exactly as printed.

in_good_standing.description: True if the certificate states that the entity is in good standing (or exists / is active) with the issuing office.

records_current_through.description: The cut-off dates of the filings the certificate reflects. These are NOT the issue date.

paper_filings_through.description: The date through which documents delivered on paper have been posted, exactly as printed. Do not reformat.

electronic_filings_through.description: The date (and time, if printed) through which documents delivered electronically are reflected, exactly as printed. Do not reformat.

issuance.description: When, where and under what number the certificate itself was issued.

issue_date.description: The date the certificate was issued (the date in the 'issued this official certificate ... on' sentence), exactly as printed. Do not reformat. Not the paper or electronic filings-through dates.

issue_time.description: The time of issue printed beside the issue date, exactly as printed (e.g. 15:57:30).

issue_place.description: The city and state where the certificate was issued, e.g. 'Denver, Colorado'.

confirmation_number.description: The certificate's confirmation or validation number, used to verify it on the state's website. Not the entity ID number.

issued_electronically.description: True if the certificate states it was issued electronically or from the state's website.

certifying_official.description: The official who certifies the facts in the certificate.

name.description: The certifying official's name as printed in the certificate text.

title.description: The official's title, e.g. 'Secretary of State of the State of Colorado'.

signature_present.description: True if a signature (including a facsimile signature) appears above the official's title.

state_seal_present.description: True if the state's great seal is affixed or reproduced on the certificate.

validation_url.description: The web address given for validating the certificate, if printed.
